text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Oguri Cap that a fan letter addressed to her has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A fan letter? For me? Whoa… What a nice surprise.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …I guess there are people supporting me even here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Cheers from the stands are great, but letters last forever.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Back in my hometown, I'd read letters over and over again for encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right. I need to try my hardest and race well—not just for my own sake, but for all of my supporters too.
